transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on finalizing the callback package for the Mara Quill role. We've got the three finalists coming in on June 18th, 9 AM to 1 PM at Studio 4. The plan includes the North Wall excerpt, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for our internal review. Before I issue the call sheet, I need each of you — counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling — to review the package. Let's hear any concerns or flags from your areas.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something on the recorded auditions component. Yesterday I reviewed the executed streamer casting addendum, and it requires that audition footage be retained for exactly 14 days and accessible only to the named casting team. I haven't entered those terms in the casting tracker yet, but they directly affect how we handle the recorded auditions in this callback package — particularly who can access the footage and the retention window.

transcript.text: I need to flag a safety concern with the movement exercise in the draft plan. My safety review of the locked action brief found that finalists must not perform a fall or handle props at callback. The physical portion must instead be an exactly 8-minute grounded choreography exercise supervised by stunt staff. I have not yet replaced the draft exercise in the call-sheet template, so we need to update that before the package goes out.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical update on the dialect side. I received the director's revised brief after the draft packet circulated, and it changes two things: the accent requirement is now Welsh-accented English, and the excerpt should be The Ferry Ledger, not North Wall. I have not yet uploaded the revised brief to the casting folder, so the draft package Maya just described still references the old excerpt. We need to update both the excerpt and the accent specification before the call sheet goes out.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical scheduling conflict. I confirmed this morning that Studio 4 is closed for a fire-systems test on June 18, so we cannot hold the callback there on that date. The available alternative is Studio 2 on June 20, from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM. This booking change is not yet on the shared calendar, so the draft plan Maya described still shows the old studio and date. We'll need to update the call sheet to reflect Studio 2, June 20, 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM before the package goes out.
